name: Internet & cloud outages
summary: No major multi-hour cloud, CDN or payments outage found 7 to 9 Nov; only minor Cloudflare incidents
state: Cloudflare's status page on 9 Nov listed two limited incidents: a Spectrum issue in Phoenix and delayed cache purges for FedRAMP customers, the latter logged by StatusGator as running 7h 10m from 6 Nov. Neither is marked as a major outage. StatusGator showed Azure operational on 9 Nov. Searches found no major multi-hour cloud, CDN or payments outage between 7 and 9 Nov.
for_you: No widespread service disruption is reported. Provider status pages give the latest position if a particular service is unavailable.
rubric_hit: No major cloud, CDN or payments outage over 2h found in the past 48h; Cloudflare items limited in scope: Normal.

sources.title: Cloudflare Status. Check if Cloudflare is down or having an outage.

why: A handful of cloud and CDN providers carry much of the internet; one bad update can halt airlines, banks and payments.
drivers: Software updates, configuration errors, attacks, power failures.

rubric.alert: Multi-hour global outage hitting payments, airlines or emergency services, ongoing or within 24h.
rubric.watch: A major cloud/CDN/payments outage > 2h in the past 48h.
rubric.normal: No major multi-hour outages in the past 48h.
